pointeduraz.name: Pointe du Raz
pointeduraz.slogan: Europe's edge, where the Atlantic and the Raz de Sein collide.
pointeduraz.line: The headland rises 72 metres above the sea, and faces the Île de Sein 8 km to the west across a strait of fierce tides.

oceanopolis.name: Océanopolis
oceanopolis.slogan: Polar, tropical and Breton seas under one roof.
oceanopolis.line: Opened on 21 June 1990, it holds about 10,000 marine animals and plants, with a million litres of seawater in the shark tank alone.

concarneauvilleclose.name: Ville Close, Concarneau
concarneauvilleclose.slogan: A walled island town afloat in its own harbour.
concarneauvilleclose.line: Its granite ramparts date from the 14th century and ring a whole town on an island, reached by a single bridge.

brestchateau.name: Château de Brest
brestchateau.slogan: Fifteen centuries guarding the Penfeld, still on duty.
brestchateau.line: Built on Roman foundations from the late 3rd century, it is called the oldest castle in the world still in use.

saintmathieupoint.name: Pointe Saint-Mathieu
saintmathieupoint.slogan: A lighthouse standing among the ruins of an abbey.
saintmathieupoint.line: Who sees Ouessant sees his blood.
